dedupe_keys.name: cocoon energy community dataset and results in laboratory environment

description: The Sevilla laboratory campaign emulates a 20 kV/400 V pilot feeder with 16 PV plants, five belonging to an energy community. Its HIL equivalent retains nine relevant PV connection nodes plus the interconnection point; a separate 400 V, 100 kVA physical equivalent aggregates three plants at N04-19. Data describe SCADA measurements, state estimates, separate JSON identification flags and scenario definitions for MbPA plus equality-constrained weighted least squares and residual testing. Condensed analytical files cover 56 unitary tests; raw time-series coverage varies and does not cover every test in every block. HIL contains one scenario block, while power-HIL includes unitary and daily-profile tests. Timestamps establish sample sequence, not campaign calendar dates. The source identifies legacy auxiliary labels that do not match actual network nodes. Native licence metadata declares CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, whereas the description explicitly declares CC BY 4.0 for data and scripts. This contradiction is unresolved; licence is recorded as unknown. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
